# Kyle Chronicles Lore Reference

This file stores the initial world/character instructions for easy reuse.

## Core Characters and Factions

- Kyle: The main character, a kid who loves Minecraft, fencing, and chess. He has a pet dog named Kenobi.
- Mortimer Mole: A mole with bad eyesight who eats squiggly worms, wears thick glasses, and lives underground. He is always nervous.
- The Nut Brigade: A collective of squirrels led by Professor Nutty who throw acorns at their enemies and wear armor.
- The Corporate Alliance: A droid and snake army who want to rule the world.
- The Daddy Republic: Christmas elves who fight against the Corporate Alliance, led by Santa.
- Todd: The son of the king and queen. He is very accident-prone, always getting into trouble, and constantly saves the day by accident.
- Gilgamesh: A wizard who looks over Todd.
- Hilgamesh: Another wizard who looks after Todd and is Gilgamesh's cousin.
- Dumbledore: A large, hulking, bearded man who helps Gilgamesh and Hilgamesh.
- Cobris: A six-headed snake king who leads the Corporate Alliance.
- Scales: Cobris's right-hand man, another anthropomorphized snake.
